name: himemo
description: Cross-platform private memo app assets and web tooling for HiMemo.

scripts.web:build: npm run web:prepare:sqljs && npm run web:build:flutter
scripts.web:build:e2e: npm run web:prepare:sqljs && npm run web:build:flutter -- --dart-define=HIMEMO_FAKE_GOOGLE_DRIVE_SYNC=true
scripts.web:serve:test: npm run web:build:e2e && serve -s -l tcp://127.0.0.1:4173 --no-port-switching build/web
